dashboard.title: Analytics
dashboard.country_lookup_unconfigured: No visitor countries are being recorded, so this map stays empty. Birdseye reads a visitor's country from a trusted proxy header such as CF-IPCountry, or failing that from a local country database. This forum has neither. Turn on "Download a country database automatically" in the Birdseye settings, set a country database file, or point the trusted country header at whatever your proxy sends.
dashboard.country_lookup_prefix_off: No visitor countries are being recorded, so this map stays empty. "Country lookup via anonymized IP prefix" is turned off, so the country database is never used. Turn that setting on, or set a trusted country header if your proxy sends one.
dashboard.country_lookup_relative: The country database file can't be used: its setting needs the full path on this server, starting with a slash, such as /home/you/geoip/GeoLite2-Country.mmdb. A relative path or a web address will not work.
dashboard.country_lookup_folder: The country database file can't be used: its setting points at a folder. Add the file name to the end of the path, such as /home/you/geoip/GeoLite2-Country.mmdb.
dashboard.country_lookup_missing: The country database file can't be used: there is no file at the path in its setting. Check the path for typos and that it ends with the file name. If the path is right, your host may not allow PHP to open files in that folder; try a folder inside your home directory.
dashboard.country_lookup_unreadable: The country database file can't be used: the file exists, but PHP is not allowed to read it. Make it readable by the user your forum runs as (permissions of 644 usually work).
dashboard.country_lookup_compressed: The country database file can't be used: it is still compressed. MaxMind's download is a .tar.gz archive. Extract it, and point the setting at the GeoLite2-Country.mmdb file inside.
dashboard.country_lookup_invalid: The country database file can't be used: the file at that path is not a MaxMind database. Point the setting at a GeoLite2-Country.mmdb file.
dashboard.country_lookup_download_failed: Birdseye couldn't download its free country database, so no visitor countries are being recorded. Your host may block outgoing connections from PHP; ask them to allow HTTPS to download.db-ip.com, or set a country database file yourself. Birdseye tries again every few hours. The error was:
dashboard.country_lookup_download_pending: No visitor countries are being recorded yet. Birdseye downloads a free country database by itself, but it hasn't run yet. That happens on Flarum's scheduler, so check that your cron job runs php flarum schedule:run every minute, or run php flarum birdseye:country-database once to fetch it now.
dashboard.country_lookup_after: Countries appear from the next day processed onwards; days already summarised cannot be filled in afterwards.
dashboard.today_note: live — becomes final when the day closes

settings.collect_help: Pause collection without disabling the extension. Existing stats keep rendering.
settings.geo_ip_prefix_label: Country lookup via anonymized IP prefix
settings.geo_ip_prefix_help: When no proxy country header is present, keep a truncated IP prefix (never the full address) in the 72-hour buffer so visitor countries can be resolved locally. Turn off to skip country stats on non-proxied traffic.
settings.geoip_auto_download_help: Keep DB-IP's free country database on this server, refreshed once a month, so visitor countries work without any setup. Only the database file is downloaded; no visitor data leaves your server, and every lookup happens here. Not used when a country database file is set below.
settings.geoip_db_path_help: Leave empty to use the automatic download above. To use your own database instead, enter the full path on this server to a MaxMind-format country database, such as the free GeoLite2-Country.mmdb (download it from maxmind.com under your own account, and extract the .mmdb file from the .tar.gz). For example /home/you/geoip/GeoLite2-Country.mmdb. Keep it outside your public web folder (public_html or similar), so the file can't be downloaded from your site, and make sure PHP can read it. Used only when no trusted proxy header supplies the country; every lookup happens on this server.
settings.country_header_help: The proxy header carrying each visitor's two-letter country code: CF-IPCountry on Cloudflare, or e.g. X-Country from nginx-geoip. It is trusted as-is, so only set a header your proxy really sets; leave it empty if you have no such proxy and rely on the anonymized IP prefix instead.
settings.weekly_digest_help: Every Monday, email administrators a summary of last week — visitors, pageviews, posts, signups, top discussion, and top search. Sent by your forum's own mailer; nothing leaves the server.

digest.subject: {forum} last week: {visitors} visitors
digest.heading: {forum} — week of {start}–{end}
digest.footer: — Link Robins Birdseye. Turn this digest off any time under Admin → Birdseye.
